featured_reviews.name: Swati Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited 99 Pancakes in Virar West, and I must say, it was an absolutely delightful experience! From the moment I walked in, I was greeted by the warm and friendly staff, who made me feel welcome and comfortable right away. The ambiance of the shop is cozy and inviting, with a charming decor that sets the perfect mood for enjoying some delicious treats. Whether you’re stopping by for a quick bite or planning to stay for a while, the atmosphere makes it a great place to relax and enjoy yourself.😊😊

Now, let's talk about the main attraction: the pancakes! The variety on offer is impressive, catering to all kinds of tastes and preferences. I decided to try a few different flavors to really get a feel for what 99 Pancakes has to offer, and I was not disappointed. The classic pancakes were light, fluffy, and perfectly cooked, with just the right amount of sweetness. They melted in my mouth with each bite, making it hard to stop at just one. The syrup and toppings that came with them were of high quality and added just the right amount of flavor without being overwhelming.🙏🏻🙏🏻✌️

But 99 Pancakes isn’t just about pancakes; they have a great selection of cakes as well. I tried a slice of their Chocolate Truffle Cake, and it was divine. The cake was moist and rich, with a deep chocolate flavor that satisfied my sweet tooth. It was topped with a luscious chocolate ganache that added an extra layer of decadence. If you’re a fan of chocolate, this is definitely a must-try! 😊😊

Another standout was their Blueberry Cheesecake, which had the perfect balance of creamy cheesecake and tart blueberry topping. The cheesecake itself was smooth and velvety, with a buttery graham cracker crust that provided a nice contrast in texture. The blueberry topping was fresh and fruity, adding a burst of flavor that complemented the cheesecake beautifully. It was a refreshing and indulgent treat that I thoroughly enjoyed.👍🏻

The beverages at 99 Pancakes are also worth mentioning. I ordered a cup of their hot chocolate to go with my pancakes, and it was heavenly. Rich, creamy, and topped with a generous amount of whipped cream, it was the perfect companion to the pancakes. They also offer a range of coffees and milkshakes, so there’s something for everyone. The menu is diverse enough to cater to different tastes, whether you're in the mood for something light and sweet or rich and indulgent.😊😊

Another aspect I appreciated was the affordability of the menu. Despite the high quality of the food and service, the prices are very reasonable. It’s refreshing to find a place where you can indulge in gourmet pancakes and desserts without breaking the bank. Whether you’re a student looking for a sweet treat or a family wanting to enjoy a nice dessert outing, 99 Pancakes offers something that fits every budget.
🙏🏻🙏🏻
Overall, my experience at 99 Pancakes in Virar West was fantastic, and I can’t recommend it enough. From the delicious food and inviting atmosphere to the friendly staff and excellent service, every aspect of my visit was top-notch. If you’re in the area and looking for a place to satisfy your sweet cravings, this is definitely the place to go. Whether you're a pancake lover, a cake enthusiast, or just someone looking for a cozy spot to relax with a cup of coffee, 99 Pancakes has something for everyone.

Thank you so much to the store staff for making my visit a memorable one. I left with a big smile on my face and a satisfied sweet tooth, and I’ll definitely be coming back for more! Keep up the great work, and see you soon!

This review should provide a comprehensive and engaging account of your experience at 99 Pancakes, highlighting various aspects of the store and its offerings.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Walking into Theobroma Virar feels like stepping into a Pinterest board—cozy, chic, and oh-so-aesthetic. The warm lighting, pastel hues, and elegant display of desserts make it almost impossible to leave without indulging.

And let’s talk about the desserts—absolute showstoppers! Each bite screams quality, from the buttery croissants to the rich, gooey brownies that can single-handedly cure a bad day. The pastries look so good that you almost feel guilty eating them… almost. Theobroma doesn’t just make desserts; they create edible pieces of art.

The brownies? Fudgy perfection. The cheesecakes? Creamy, smooth, and just the right amount of sweet. Even the simple tea cakes taste like they’ve been baked by angels. Every bite confirms one thing—they don’t cut corners when it comes to ingredients. You can taste the richness, the freshness, and most importantly, the love.

Service is friendly, and the place has a welcoming vibe, making it great for a quick bite or a long chat over coffee. Prices? Well, quality comes at a cost, but when the food is this good, you won’t regret it.

Final verdict—Theobroma Virar is a dessert lover’s paradise. Go for the brownies, stay for the vibes, and leave with a happy (and slightly sugar-high) heart.

description: Over the course of eight decades, a lot has changed about us. We have relocated, undergone expansion, developed new product lines & added segments, opened retail chains & stores across India and embraced new markets overseas. One thing hasn't changed - we're still a tight-knit family business, committed to serving the most authentic taste of India through our products. featured_reviews.name: Tathagata Das
featured_reviews.review_text:
It’s extremely disappointing to see a reputed brand like Haldiram’s follow such questionable billing practices.

Displaying menu prices without GST and then adding it later is not just misleading—it goes against the basic principle of transparent pricing expected under GST rules. As a customer, you have the right to know the final amount upfront, not be surprised at the time of billing.

This kind of hidden charge approach damages trust and reflects poorly on customer ethics. Big brands should set better standards, not exploit loopholes or confuse customers with unclear pricing.

I strongly urge everyone to be cautious and always check the bill carefully. If needed, raise the issue with the management or report it through proper consumer channels.

Customers deserve honesty—not surprises at the counter.

featured_reviews.name: Gabrial Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
Haldiram has arrived in virar west in red bricks .
The store has  2 floors ground floor is full of sweets( mithais) and dry fruits, there's on counter for ice cream as well!
Top floor is a restaurant where you have to order like mc d , or any other fast food restaurant, then they serve you to your table.
Rajkarchori is one the best and most selling item I noticed.
It's good veg lovers will love it.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Gabrial Fernandes,

Seeing that you had a excellent experience is the best thing we could hope for! Your review means a lot to us. Thank you for choosing Haldiram's. We look forward to serving you for many years to come!

Haldiram's Team

featured_reviews.name: Divya Master
featured_reviews.review_text:
Atmosphere was good, spacious and 4-5 families can accommodate.

Food quality was meh, not good and not par to the taste.
We had ordered onion uttapam, Dahi Chat, cheese sada dosa and Aloo tikki chat

Sambhar was very sweet and tangy, sambhar should be spicy as far as I know.  Chutney was good jn taste and dahi chat was amazing.

This is like the food you wanna try once in some shop.  Will be coming here but only for their famous Raj Kachori and not for any other items.

Rating- 2.5/5
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Divya Master,

Thank you for sharing your detailed feedback with us. We're glad to hear that you enjoyed the spacious atmosphere, along with the chutney and dahi chat. We're sorry to hear that some of the dishes didn't meet your expectations. Your feedback about the sambar will be shared with our culinary team for review. We appreciate your loyalty and look forward to serving you again for the Raj Kachori.

Team Haldiram's
Call us on 7030000146 OR mail us on customer.relations@haldirams.com

featured_reviews.name: Rakeshh Jaadhav
featured_reviews.review_text: Very good ambiance. Variety of food options.. However a way on expensive side. Rs. 109+taxes for something like pani puri and dahi puri is not that practical. Further the service was very slow. However, it might be because the outlet was newly opened and they were that expecting that overwhelming response. However, overall a good experience. Yet to try a lot of other food option. Management must think about revising the rates..
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Rakesh Jadhav, 

Thanks very much for your balanced and fair review of Haldiram's. We're working hard on improving our services and we're pleased our efforts resonated with you. 

I also want to thank you for your feedback and criticisms. We've taken your thoughts to heart and we're planning on making some internal changes based on your recommendations. 

I appreciate your kind words and professional demeanour and look forward to seeing more of your work in the future. 
Best, 

Team Haldiram's
Call us at 7030000146

Highly recommended for anyone looking to make their celebrations extra special!

featured_reviews.name: Shivkant Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I ordered a cake from this place for my son's birthday yesterday, but the cake that arrived was utterly substandard, disappointing, and a complete waste of money.

The cake tasted awful, had a foul, foul flavor, and didn't seem fresh at all. The cream tasted as if it were several days old.

Forget about the design and finishing—there was a huge difference between what was shown in the order and what was delivered. They completely ruined a special occasion like a child's birthday.

Despite charging so much money, there was no trace of quality, hygiene, or professionalism.

I would absolutely not recommend anyone ordering a cake from here.
